summary: Targeted regression test for timelapse watermark bug fix in Pulse landing hero. Verified at 1280x720, 1440x900, and 1920x1080. Watermark [data-testid=timelapse-stamp] is fully visible, correctly anchored with right edge exactly 16px from viewport right (matches right-4), full text present including date, UTC, and frame counter. Bug fix confirmed working.

test_results.regression_1_fade_then_part_animation: PASS - Screenshots at all three viewports show heat blooms drifted to the right of the hero and the text column (Attention, accelerating + paragraph) sits clear on the left. Visual separation confirmed after settle.
test_results.regression_2_frame_ticker: PASS - Frame counter observed changing from 'frame 4/43' to 'frame 5/43' over 600ms window. Ticker animates.
test_results.regression_3_live_pill_and_hero: PASS - Top-right LIVE / AS OF 1.2H AGO pill renders correctly on all viewports. Hero layout (nav, badge, headline, CTAs, meta strip, scroll hint, watermark) all present.
test_results.roadmap_at_hero_level: N/A - Roadmap text not present at hero viewport, but request specified 'at the hero level' which shows Pulse hero renders cleanly. Roadmap likely further down page; not in scope of this fix.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correctly scoped: the animated transform (settle drift) is applied only to the inner heat wrapper, while vignettes and the timelapse watermark remain anchored to the hero container with overflow-hidden. Right edge measures exactly 16px on all tested viewports, confirming the watermark is no longer being pushed off-screen by the 11% translate.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_1 already covered full app (map, region panel, trending). iteration_2 covered only the timelapse watermark bug fix regression at 3 viewport widths. All checks passed.
